testCase:
F-03: The link appears after the form
Goal: Download the report for the last 30 days as a CSV file.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/f-03/
STEP 2: Choose "Last 30 days" in "Date range"
STEP 3: Choose "CSV" in "Format"
STEP 4: Click "Generate report"
STEP 5: Click "Download report"
STEP 6: Verify "Saved report-last-30-days.csv" is visible
STEP 7: Verify the downloaded file "report-last-30-days.csv" contains the line "range,last-30-days"

plan.title: F-03: Generate and download a 30-day CSV report

steps.note: Choose and confirm the requested reporting period.
Generate the report to reveal its download link.
Activate the generated report's download link.
Verify the exact visible saved confirmation without treating it as proof of downloaded file contents.

reasoning: This tests generating a CSV report for the last 30 days and clicking the download link that appears after generation. The plan checks the visible saved confirmation, but the catalog cannot inspect the downloaded file to verify its contents.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Inspect the downloaded file "report-last-30-days.csv" and verify it contains the line "range,last-30-days".
